name: widgetworks-order-support-agent
description: Looks up orders, issues refunds, and replies to customer support tickets for the Widgetworks online store. Escalates disputed charges to a dedicated billing agent.

skills.name: Look up an order
skills.description: Retrieve order status and history for a customer.

skills.name: Issue a refund
skills.description: Issue a refund against a completed order.

skills.name: Reply to customer
skills.description: Send a support reply email to the customer who opened the ticket.

skills.name: Bulk refund orders
skills.description: Refund every order in a batch when a fulfilment run fails, without a per-order reviewer.
